basics.description: Deploy a complete, network-isolated **Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL rapid migration POC**: a Windows workstation (Visual Studio Code + the Microsoft PostgreSQL extension), an Oracle source database, an Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, and an Azure OpenAI (Microsoft Foundry) deployment for AI-assisted conversion. All resources sit inside a single virtual network and are reached privately over Azure Bastion. [Learn more](https://github.com/MicrosoftLearning/mslearn-postgresql/tree/main/Allfiles/Deploy).

basics.name: adminUsername
basics.label: Administrator username
basics.toolTip: The local administrator account for the workstation VM (also used as the RDP login and as the Oracle and PostgreSQL admin login).

basics.name: adminPassword
basics.toolTip: Login password. Reused for the workstation RDP login and the Oracle and PostgreSQL admin accounts. 12-123 characters, and must include at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, and one digit. The double-quote character is not allowed.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 12-123 characters (no spaces or double-quotes) with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, and one digit.

elements.name: selected
elements.label: Components to deploy
elements.toolTip: Select one or more components. Use Select all for the complete migration environment.

allowedValues.label: Workstation and Azure Bastion
allowedValues.description: Windows migration workstation with private RDP access through Azure Bastion.

allowedValues.label: Oracle source
allowedValues.description: Oracle Database Free 23ai with the sample HR schema.

allowedValues.label: PostgreSQL target
allowedValues.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server and migration sandbox database.

allowedValues.label: AI conversion
allowedValues.description: Azure OpenAI account and model for AI-assisted schema conversion.

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: Workstation VM size
elements.toolTip: Size of the Windows workstation VM. Pick a family you have vCPU quota for in this region.

elements.name: oracleVmSize
elements.label: Oracle VM size
elements.toolTip: Size of the Linux VM that hosts the Oracle source database container.

elements.name: postgresSkuTier
elements.label: PostgreSQL compute tier
elements.toolTip: Compute tier for the flexible server. Burstable is the most economical choice for a lab.

elements.name: openAiDeploymentName
elements.label: Model deployment name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Azure OpenAI model deployment used for the conversion.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 2-64 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
